title: dismissal ranks, does not mute

setup.note: Two "Not now" taps on fare-alert cards (kind something_moved). The third fare alert still exists on every durable surface; it has simply sunk below the kinds the user still reads, and takes the card once nothing outranks it.

dismiss.intent: fare on the watched route dropped
fare on the watched route dropped again

items.intent: fare on the watched route dropped once more

input_events: Two "Not now" taps on fare-alert cards.
A third fare alert arrives alongside a done-for-you artifact.

expected.note: That kind's priority drops; the third still reaches the panel; it earns a card only after the kinds above it decay.

wrong.label: dismissal-mutes
wrong.assert_absent: a kind that stops reaching the panel because it was dismissed twice

wrong.label: dismissal-ignored
wrong.assert_absent: a twice-dismissed kind still outranking the kinds the user keeps reading
